rationale: The plan correctly identifies the perfect confounding, refuses a batch term (not full rank) and explicitly forbids ComBat-seq/SVA/removeBatchEffect, then runs the only estimable model ~condition with every result labeled confounded and a closing recommendation to rebalance the design — exactly the reference behavior. QC is design-specific (blind VST, PCA colored by condition with the note that condition and batch are the same axis, sample distances, library sizes), though the outlier handling policy is only 'flag', not a stated action rule. The filter (≥10 counts in ≥6 samples, justified by smallest group size), DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization inside the model, explicit reference level and contrast, BH at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering and apeglm shrinkage are all correct and stated. Enrichment is arguably not warranted on a ranking that is itself confounded, but it is run only as explicitly hypothesis-generating and is otherwise fully specified (full ranked list, Wald stat metric, named collections with versions, 15–500 size window, leading edge, BH), so it loses only a little. The report section names versions, design, thresholds, tested and significant gene counts, diagnostics, and leads with the confounding caveat.
